newsitem.title: GERMANY: DBV-Winterthur sells unit to Provinzial.
newsitem.headline: DBV-Winterthur sells unit to Provinzial.

text.p: German insurer DBV-Winterthur Holding AG said on Wednesday it was selling its combined stake of 100 percent in insurer Hamburger Feuerkasse Versicherungs-AG to Provinzial Versicherungsgruppe.
DBV Winterthur said it would earn a book profit from the sale which would boost its 1997 results.
The sale takes effect on January 1, 1997, DBV-Winterthur said in a statement.
Provinzial had taken over all DBV-Winterthur's commitments to Hamburger Feuerkasse, ensuring that the subsidiary would remain a separate legal entity, the statement said.
The companies' supervisory boards have yet to approve the move.
